rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping production robotics systems (drones at Skycatch, autonomous tractors at Agtonomy) and is now focused on real-time infrastructure for robotics at LiveKit, while Manjot has 15+ years of software development and mobile app experience across iOS, Android, and cross-platform frameworks like Flutter and React Native. Though their primary domains don't overlap, David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time infrastructure and observability tooling, combined with Manjot's track record scaling software teams and delivering complex systems for 200+ global clients, could surface interesting conversations around how mobile and edge infrastructure patterns might apply to robotics challenges.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Manjot Singh — you're both deeply experienced in shipping complex software systems at scale (robotics production vs. mobile/IT services across 200+ clients), and there may be useful patterns to swap around real-time observability and team scaling.
